# Ah Huat Poultry

# Festive periods

How we run the stall around the big holidays. Read this a month before each one.
## Chinese New Year
We close on the first, second and third day of Chinese New Year. We reopen on the fourth
day.
Take pre-orders for whole roast chickens from one week before. Write each order in the red
book with the name, phone number and pick-up time. Ask for a $10 deposit.
Three days before Chinese New Year, double the chicken order from Ah Huat, to 60 birds a
day, and tell him by the week before. Seng Kee should also send 5 kg of extra wings.
Hire one extra helper for the last four days before Chinese New Year. Pay is $120 a day in
hongbao.
The hawker centre has its spring cleaning the week before; check the NEA notice for the
exact days.
## Hari Raya Puasa
Many regular customers from the nearby offices take leave, so lunch is quieter. Order 20
percent fewer chickens on the day itself and the day after.
## Deepavali
The stall stays open. Kumar takes the day off, so Ah Mei needs help from the boss’s nephew
at lunch.
## Christmas and New Year’s Eve
Offices close early. Expect a smaller lunch and a busier dinner if we open late. We close
at 3pm on New Year’s Eve.
## National Day
The hawker centre is crowded in the evening because of the fireworks. We stay open until
9pm and order 10 more chickens.
## Notes from past years
### 2023
We took 70 chickens a day for three days before Chinese New Year and still sold out by
1pm. The extra helper was Kumar’s cousin.
### 2024
Pre-orders for whole roast chickens reached 45. We closed on the first three days of the
new year and reopened on day 4 with a short menu.
### 2025
Ah Huat raised his price by 50 cents a bird in the two weeks before Chinese New Year.
Order early to lock in the price.
### January checklist

retrieved.title: Hygiene routine
retrieved.text:
# Hygiene routine

## Every day

- Wash hands with soap before handling food and after touching money.
- Red chopping board for raw chicken, green for cooked chicken. Never swap them.
- Check the chiller temperature twice a day, at opening and at 2pm. It must be between 0 and 4 degrees. Write it in the log book.
- Throw away cooked chicken that has been out for more than 4 hours.

## Every week

- Saturday after closing: scrub the chopping boards with bleach and soak the ladles.

retrieved.text:
# When equipment breaks

## Rice cooker trips the power

Unplug the rice cooker, then reset the breaker switch in the electrical box next to stall 12. Plug it back in after a minute. If it trips again, use the small spare cooker.

## Chiller not cold

Check the door seal and that nothing blocks the fan at the back. If it is still above 4 degrees after an hour, call Lim Refrigeration at 9555 1212 and move the chicken to the ice box.

## Gas smell

Close the gas valve at the cylinder, put out all flames and do not switch on anything electrical. Call Seng Gas's emergency line, 6123 4567, and tell the hawker centre office.

# Helper rules

For Ah Mei and Kumar.

## Shifts

- Morning shift 6am to 3pm. Ah Mei opens, Kumar comes at 9am.
- Break of 15 minutes at 11am, before the lunch crowd.

- Count the float in the morning: $100 in small notes and coins.

## Medical leave

- If you are sick, call the boss before 5am so he can find a replacement.

How we run the stall around the big holidays. Read this a month before each one.
## Chinese New Year
We close on the first, second and third day of Chinese New Year. We reopen on the fourth
day.
Take pre-orders for whole roast chickens from one week before. Write each order in the red
book with the name, phone number and pick-up time. Ask for a $10 deposit.
Three days before Chinese New Year, double the chicken order from Ah Huat, to 60 birds a
day, and tell him by the week before. Seng Kee should also send 5 kg of extra wings.
Hire one extra helper for the last four days before Chinese New Year. Pay is $120 a day in
hongbao.
The hawker centre has its spring cleaning the week before; check the NEA notice for the
exact days.
## Hari Raya Puasa
Many regular customers from the nearby offices take leave, so lunch is quieter. Order 20
percent fewer chickens on the day itself and the day after.
## Deepavali
The stall stays open. Kumar takes the day off, so Ah Mei needs help from the boss’s nephew
at lunch.
## Christmas and New Year’s Eve
Offices close early. Expect a smaller lunch and a busier dinner if we open late. We close
at 3pm on New Year’s Eve.
## National Day
The hawker centre is crowded in the evening because of the fireworks. We stay open until
9pm and order 10 more chickens.
## Notes from past years
### 2023
We took 70 chickens a day for three days before Chinese New Year and still sold out by
1pm. The extra helper was Kumar’s cousin.
### 2024
Pre-orders for whole roast chickens reached 45. We closed on the first three days of the
new year and reopened on day 4 with a short menu.
### 2025
Ah Huat raised his price by 50 cents a bird in the two weeks before Chinese New Year.
Order early to lock in the price.
### January checklist

retrieved.text:
# When equipment breaks

## Rice cooker trips the power

Unplug the rice cooker, then reset the breaker switch in the electrical box next to stall 12. Plug it back in after a minute. If it trips again, use the small spare cooker.

## Chiller not cold

Check the door seal and that nothing blocks the fan at the back. If it is still above 4 degrees after an hour, call Lim Refrigeration at 9555 1212 and move the chicken to the ice box.

## Gas smell

Close the gas valve at the cylinder, put out all flames and do not switch on anything electrical. Call Seng Gas's emergency line, 6123 4567, and tell the hawker centre office.

# Ah Huat Poultry

Our main chicken supplier, for whole chickens.

- Contact: Uncle Huat, 9123 4567 (call or WhatsApp).
- Order by 9pm for delivery the next morning at 6am.
- Minimum order is 10 birds. Usually we take 30 on weekdays and 40 on Saturdays.
- Closed on Sundays, so order Monday's chickens on Saturday night.
- Pay by PayNow at the end of each week. He sends the invoice on Friday.

If the chickens come late, call before 6.30am so we still have time to boil them.

retrieved.title: Hygiene routine
retrieved.text:
# Hygiene routine

## Every day

- Wash hands with soap before handling food and after touching money.
- Red chopping board for raw chicken, green for cooked chicken. Never swap them.
- Check the chiller temperature twice a day, at opening and at 2pm. It must be between 0 and 4 degrees. Write it in the log book.
- Throw away cooked chicken that has been out for more than 4 hours.

## Every week

- Saturday after closing: scrub the chopping boards with bleach and soak the ladles.
